[LIMP.2.1.4] **Dotted paths.** A dotted library path
(`units.si`, `adapters.aws.s3`) selects a hierarchical
library. The library path in source uses the full dotted form,
and one more `.` joins it to a member: `import units.si` reaches
the SI library's `meter` as `units.si.meter` ([LGRA.22.9]). The
selective form's body remains a flat list of bare names:
`from units.si import meter, kilogram`.
